talking_points: OpenAI's valuation has jumped to $1.25 trillion on a fresh $11bn capital injection, even as rival Anthropic's IPO plans reportedly shrink.
Microsoft is said to be stepping back from renting Oracle's AI cloud capacity, a sign hyperscalers are rethinking which compute deals they actually need.
Wall Street is slicing up AI infrastructure debt - from CoreWeave's bonds to SpaceX's chip lease - spreading the financial risk of the AI buildout far beyond Silicon Valley.
